entries.title: Proverbs 27:1
segments: ¶Do not make a noise about tomorrow, for you are not certain what a day's outcome may be.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:2
segments: ¶Let another man give you praise, and not your mouth; one who is strange to you, and not your lips.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:3
segments: ¶A stone has great weight, and sand is crushing; but the wrath of the foolish is of greater weight than these.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:4
segments: Wrath is cruel, and angry feeling an overflowing stream; but who does not give way before envy?

entries.title: Proverbs 27:5
segments: ¶Better is open protest than love kept secret.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:6
segments: The wounds of a friend are given in good faith, but the kisses of a hater are false.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:7
segments: ¶The full man has no use for honey, but to the man in need of food every bitter thing is sweet.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:8
segments: ¶Like a bird wandering from the place of her eggs is a man wandering from his station.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:9
segments: ¶Oil and perfume make glad the heart, and the wise suggestion of a friend is sweet to the soul.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:10
segments: Do not give up your friend and your father's friend; and do not go into your brother's house in the day of your trouble: better is a neighbour who is near than a brother far off.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:11
segments: ¶My son, be wise and make my heart glad, so that I may give back an answer to him who puts me to shame.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:12
segments: ¶The sharp man sees the evil and takes cover: the simple go straight on and get into trouble.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:13
segments: ¶Take a man's clothing if he makes himself responsible for a strange man, and get an undertaking from him who gives his word for strange men.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:14
segments: ¶He who gives a blessing to his friend with a loud voice, getting up early in the morning, will have it put to his account as a curse.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:15
segments: ¶Like an unending dropping on a day of rain is a bitter-tongued woman.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:16
segments: He who keeps secret the secret of his friend, will get himself a name for good faith.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:17
segments: ¶Iron makes iron sharp; so a man makes sharp his friend.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:18
segments: ¶Whoever keeps a fig-tree will have its fruit; and the servant waiting on his master will be honoured.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:19
segments: ¶Like face looking at face in water, so are the hearts of men to one another.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:20
segments: ¶The underworld and Abaddon are never full, and the eyes of man have never enough.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:21
segments: ¶The heating-pot is for silver and the oven-fire for gold, and a man is measured by what he is praised for.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:22
segments: ¶Even if a foolish man is crushed with a hammer in a vessel among crushed grain, still his foolish ways will not go from him.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:23
segments: ¶Take care to have knowledge about the condition of your flocks, looking well after your herds;

entries.title: Proverbs 27:24
segments: For wealth is not for ever, and money does not go on for all generations.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:25
segments: The grass comes up and the young grass is seen, and the mountain plants are got in.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:26
segments: The lambs are for your clothing, and the he-goats make the value of a field:

entries.title: Proverbs 27:27
segments: There will be goats' milk enough for your food, and for the support of your servant-girls.
